name: Inmarsat
tagline: GEO mobile comms — maritime, aviation, GMDSS backbone
description: Geostationary mobile-satellite communications — 14+ satellites in GEO providing maritime, aviation, and remote-area voice + data services. Originally founded 1979 as the International Maritime Satellite Organization, an intergovernmental treaty body for ship-to-shore comms (the predecessor of GMDSS). Privatised 1999. Acquired by Viasat in 2023 to combine with Viasat's Ka-band fleet.
best_known_for: GEO mobile comms — maritime, aviation, GMDSS backbone
